burncinema.Madness.Title: Perception of Madness
burncinema.Madness.NoPlayers: No users. Connect a player to the table.
burncinema.Madness.StopAllHint: For every target: ambient 0, nothing held, own music off
burncinema.Madness.StatusNone: No data from the target: not in the game or no status yet.
burncinema.Madness.ProblemImg: appearance “{name}” not applied: the image failed to load for the target
burncinema.Madness.ProblemTokens: appearance “{name}” not applied: its tokens are not on the target's scene
burncinema.Madness.StoppedBanner: The player pressed stop. Nothing is shown to them until you lift it.
burncinema.Madness.TargetStopped: The target pressed stop — lift it first
burncinema.Madness.StopSelf: Madness stop is on: visions removed, the GM will see it. Only the GM can bring them back.
burncinema.Madness.StopKeyHint: Immediately removes every Perception of Madness vision for you. The GM sees that you pressed stop; only the GM can bring visions back.
burncinema.Madness.AmbientHint: Now and then flashes one vision marked with the die. Higher strength means more often and longer.
burncinema.Madness.AmbientNeedsIntensity: Vision added to the ambient pool. Raise the strength above zero for ambient to run.
burncinema.Madness.InAmbient: In the ambient set — click to remove
burncinema.Madness.HoldHint: Hold until you lift it (survives F5)
burncinema.Madness.DeleteConfirm: Delete vision “{name}”? It disappears for every target.
burncinema.Madness.SelectTokens: Select tokens on the scene — this list updates by itself. Shift adds more.
burncinema.Madness.SelectObjects: Select tokens or tiles on the scene — this list updates by itself. Shift adds more.
burncinema.Madness.SelectionReplaces: The selection replaces the vision's objects.
burncinema.Madness.SelectionKeeps: Now: {what}. Select others on the scene to replace them.
burncinema.Madness.KindHint.appearance: Selected tokens look different to the target: another image and/or another name.
burncinema.Madness.KindHint.phantom: Selected hidden tokens or tiles are visible only to the target — lit and fogged like real ones. Place and move them with the usual tools.
burncinema.Madness.KindHint.vanish: Selected tokens or tiles disappear for the target. Everyone else sees them as usual.
burncinema.Madness.KindHint.tint: Shifts the colour of the whole screen for the target. Works on any scene.
burncinema.Madness.KindHint.sound: A sound only the target hears: a flash plays it once, holding loops it.
burncinema.Madness.LabelPlaceholder: Another name above the token (empty — keep)
burncinema.Madness.ByActor: For every token of these actors on any scene
burncinema.Madness.AutoHide: Hide the selection from everyone else (hidden)
burncinema.Madness.NeedImageOrLabel: Set an image, another name or change the look settings
burncinema.Madness.NeedTokens: Select the tokens whose guise changes
burncinema.Madness.NeedActorTokens: The selected tokens have no actors
burncinema.Madness.NeedObjects: Select tokens or tiles on the scene
burncinema.Madness.MusicPlaceholder: YouTube link/ID or audio file path…
burncinema.Madness.MusicFromLM: Take the track playing in Lazy Music
burncinema.Madness.MusicIsolate: Isolation: shared music won't override the target's track
burncinema.Madness.MusicIsolateHint: Without isolation the next shared track replaces the madness music, and the target goes back to the shared music with everyone.
burncinema.Madness.NeedTrack: Set a YouTube link/ID or an audio file path
burncinema.Madness.NoLMTrack: Nothing is playing in Lazy Music right now
